kpis.signal: 310 Mds puces Arm cumulees. Architecture la plus pervasive au monde. 7.9 Mds livrees Q4 FY25 seul.
kpis.description_fr: Nombre cumule de puces basees architecture Arm rapportees livrees. Plus de 310 milliards a fin FY25. Indicateur de pervasivite architectural.
kpis.description_en: Cumulative count of Arm-based chips reported shipped. Over 310 billion as of end FY25. Architectural pervasiveness metric.

kpis.signal: 46% des royalties Arm proviennent des processeurs apps mobiles FY25. Quasi-monopole sur smartphones.
kpis.description_fr: Part des royalties Arm provenant des processeurs applications mobiles (smartphones). Quasi-monopole architectural sur ce marche.
kpis.description_en: Share of Arm royalty revenue from mobile applications processors (smartphones). Architectural near-monopoly in this market.

kpis.signal: License revenue +35% FY25 ($370 M absolu). Demande Armv9 et Compute Subsystems forte.
kpis.description_fr: Croissance License revenue FY25 vs FY24. Inclut nouveaux licensees Armv9 + Compute Subsystems pour data center / AI.
kpis.description_en: License revenue growth FY25 vs FY24. Includes new Armv9 licensees + Compute Subsystems for data center / AI.

kpis.signal: +27% revenu clients externes ($675 M absolu). Mix royalties + licenses ameliore (taux royalty per chip plus eleve).
kpis.description_fr: Croissance revenu clients externes FY25 vs FY24. Mix superieur avec montee royalty rates per chip et CSS.
kpis.description_en: External customer revenue growth FY25 vs FY24. Higher mix from royalty rates per chip + CSS adoption.

_notes: Source: 20-F Arm Holdings plc FY25 (ending Mar 31 2025) SEC EDGAR. Exercice fiscal decale (avril-mars).
